title: BC Hydro Customer Crisis Fund 2026: Up to $800 Bill Grant
desc: BC Hydro's Customer Crisis Fund pays up to $800 (electric heat) or $700 toward an overdue bill if you face disconnection. Who qualifies and how to apply.
h1: BC Hydro Bill Help 2026: The Customer Crisis Fund
badge: Up to $800 for a BC Hydro bill
lead: If you fell behind on your BC Hydro bill after a job loss, a medical bill or a death in the family, BC Hydro has a grant that can pay the overdue amount. It is the main bill-help program on BC Hydro's side. Here is who can apply, the dollar limits and how fast it works.
cards_heading: What we found for British Columbia heating help
cards_intro: Each card names the official page we read on October 21, 2026. Dollar amounts are the government's own; anything it does not publish, we do not show.

cards.title: Customer Crisis Fund grant
cards.note: A grant equal to your overdue balance, up to $800 if you heat with electricity and $700 if you do not. It is paid straight to your BC Hydro account. One grant per account holder each year.

cards.title: Climate Action Tax Credit
cards.note: The final quarterly payment was issued in April 2025. Unfiled past returns may still earn back payments.

sections: The Customer Crisis Fund is for residential customers who are facing disconnection even though they have tried to pay. You apply for a grant toward the overdue balance. The grant matches what you owe, up to the cap, so a smaller bill gets a smaller grant.

You must be a residential account holder applying for your main home. Your payments must be overdue by at least 21 days or you must be facing disconnection. You must have had a life event in the last 12 months that caused a temporary financial crisis, such as losing a job or benefit income, an unexpected medical cost or a death in the family. Your outstanding balance must be $1,000 or less, and you must have tried to make payments.
BC Hydro says that once you submit an application, disconnection activity is put on hold until it has been reviewed. That is the reason to apply right away if you have a notice.

Online is the fastest way. You can also fill in a paper form from a Service BC location, bring it to Service BC if you live outside the Lower Mainland, mail it to PO Box 8910, Vancouver, B.C., V6B 4X3, or fax it to 604 909 4861. For help, call 2-1-1 (BC211) or contact a participating community service organization.

BC Hydro also offers payment plans, deferring a payment in your MyHydro account, and equal payment plans that spread winter costs across the year. Call 1 800 224 9376 to set one up. Ask about them before you fall far behind.
The Climate Action Tax Credit has ended

The BC Climate Action Tax Credit is over. The final quarterly payment was issued in April 2025, and it was paid through the income tax return. If you never filed returns for past years, such as 2021 to 2024, filing them may still bring back amounts you were owed. Check the BC government page before you count on it. Separately, one BC Hydro page was reported to show an older $600 cap; the Customer Crisis Fund page we read says $800 and $700.
A grant clears one bill. Rebates for insulation, heat pumps and thermostats lower the next ones. See the BC pages below.

If your application is denied and your circumstances change, BC Hydro says you can apply again in the same year. Keep any letter you receive, and ask a community service organization to help you add the missing paper.
claim_heading: What to do in British Columbia this winter
claim_steps: Check that you have a recent life event and a balance of $1,000 or less.
Apply online or use a Service BC form right away.

faq: How much is the BC Hydro Customer Crisis Fund?
Up to $800 if you heat with electricity and up to $700 if you do not, equal to your overdue balance.
Who can get a Customer Crisis Fund grant?
Residential account holders with a crisis in the last 12 months, an overdue balance of $1,000 or less and some attempt to pay.
Will BC Hydro cut my power while I wait?
BC Hydro says disconnection activity is put on hold once your application is submitted, until it is reviewed.
How often can I get a grant?
One grant per account holder each year. If you are denied and your situation changes, you can apply again in the same year.
